answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the juniper log shows the live set and the tide audit records each lapse. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 336 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Keeping 160 aliases alive hence means 160 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the dune quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. That is 22 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
